name: TEMP Look inside Etsy notices (read only)

parameters.content:
## TEMP - Look inside Etsy notice e-mails (READ ONLY)

Finds the Etsy conversation notices of one client in Jack's mailbox, takes the first, a middle and the last one, and shows for each: the cleaned text, the links inside the e-mail, and the attachment list. Purpose: find out whether the client's real message text and photos are in the e-mail at all, or only on Etsy. Reads one mailbox, changes nothing. Delete when done.
